new_value: Fixed: git-state pin in llm_semantic_merge() snapshots symbolic-ref, HEAD, MERGE_HEAD hash, and the staged-name set (conflicted paths excluded, --no-renames) before the timeout-900 LLM session; any mutation post-session triggers a status-checked symbolic-ref repoint + reset --hard (FATAL exit 2 on any rewind failure — set -e is suppressed in the if-condition call context; DETACHED-start fail-stops). Verified with a 12-scenario sandbox suite (rogue commit, branch switch, self-abort, merge-parent swap, foreign staging, stale index.lock, detached start, .beads discard policy, accept-ours/accept-theirs no-false-positive, happy/fail paths) — all pass; bash -n + shellcheck clean. 4 delegated reviewer rounds (kimi-k3): rounds 1-3 found branch-switch bypass, unchecked reset, MERGE_HEAD content swap, foreign staging, accept-ours false positive — all fixed; round 4 converged (one finding deduped into x79p via comment). Follow-ups filed: nm0h (residual attack surface: refs/hooks/push/untracked), ka0l (pre-existing dead staging block). One security pass (round 2) timed out at 300s and was rerun successfully at 600s.
